paragraphs: DBI approves plans and issues permits for all construction in the City. We make sure buildings are safe and comply with building and housing codes.
Permit Services and inspections will resume operations on Thursday, November 12, 2026.

sections.heading: About
paragraphs: Under the direction and management of the seven-member citizen Building Inspection Commission, to oversee the effective, efficient, fair and safe enforcement of the City and County of San Francisco's Building, Housing, Plumbing, Electrical, and Mechanical Codes, along with the Disability Access Regulations.

sections.heading: Contact information › Address
paragraphs: We are closed on public holidays. Plan Review and Print Center queues will close at 4:30pm. Payments, general questions and assistance are available until 5:00pm.
